text.en:
EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 479 February 2, 1977
FIXING THE AMOUNT OF ASSISTANCE TO PRIMARY GOLD PRODUCERS
In implementation of Presidential Decree No. 1070, providing assistance to primary gold producers, and upon
recommendation of the Monetary Board of the Central Bank, the amount of assistance is hereby fixed as
A primary gold producer whose annual production exceeds 75,000 ounces shall, upon application, receive an
assistance equivalent to 70% of the positive difference between its cost of production (excluding depreciation,
depletion, amortization and rehabilitation costs, and main office overhead) per ounce and the proceeds of sale,
during each quarter, per ounce of its gold production: Provided, That the assistance shall in no case exceed
P300 per ounce; and Provided, further, That such assistance shall not exceed the amount by which P1,050
exceeds the sales proceeds per ounce.
A primary gold producer whose annual production does not exceed 75,000 ounces shall, upon application,
receive an assistance equivalent to 75% of the positive difference between its cost of production (excluding
depreciation, depletion, amortization of rehabilitation costs, and main office overhead) per ounce and the
proceeds of sale, during each quarter, per ounce of its gold production: Provided, That the assistance shall in
no case exceeds P300 per ounce; and Provided, further, That such assistance shall not exceed the amount by
which P1,125 exceeds the sales proceeds per ounce.
The assistance hereinabove provided shall apply to gold produced commencing January 1, 1977 until
Done in the City of Manila, this 2nd day of February, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-seven.
